summary: Added a strictly READ-ONLY MCP tool contract module cli_adapter_readonly_tool.py that exposes the B105 dryrun adapter as read-only tools: plan_command_readonly returns a validated would-run launch plan WITHOUT appending any audit entry (plan_dryrun audit=False), audit_summary_readonly returns a read-only summary of the write-gate audit log (core.read_audit_log), and readonly_tool_report returns both in one call. Launches nothing: no subprocess/exec/fork/shell code exists and no env flag can enable launch (launch_enabled()=False, LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED=False). Read-only holds even with AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1 -- the plan tool writes ZERO audit lines. Env values (incl. secrets) are redacted in plan/report/audit output. server.py is intentionally untouched; register(mcp) makes the future gated wiring a one-liner (tracked in the next wave).

invariant.launch_enable_flag_has_no_effect: AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH ignored; no launcher exists in this contract
invariant.plan_audit_write: plan_command_readonly calls plan_dryrun(audit=False); zero audit lines appended even with AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1

public_api.plan_command_readonly(task_id, runner, t: validated plan dict; writes nothing; redacts env
public_api.audit_summary_readonly(max_entries=100,: read-only audit-log summary (counts + last N entries)
public_api.contract_summary(): static read-only contract shape, no side effects
public_api.register(mcp): register the 3 read-only tools on a FastMCP-like server; returns names; NOT called here (server wiring deferred)

neural_bridge_note: Static command/adapter allowlist (inherited from B105) is a human-configured SAFETY boundary, not a runtime cue router. Future adapter/runner/topic launch selection must become a LEARNED routing + abstain policy tracked as MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1; no regex/keyword cognition becomes launch authority. This module is a read-only VIEW and decides no capability.
no_launch_code_marker: This module and its tests contain NO process-launch code: no subprocess import, no child-process spawn, no os-level exec/fork, no shell invocation. Launch/process code arrives only in gated follow-ups behind all launch_preconditions.
